speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of fluctuating diplopia, ptosis, and fatigable proximal muscle weakness (climbing stairs, arm weakness) that worsens with activity is the classic clinical presentation of this autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder. To confirm, I would request a Tensilon (edrophonium) test and check for anti-AChR antibodies.
